hook.name: AgroLastro PoolAGL
hook.description: PoolAGL deploys the AGL token and initializes an AGL/USDC Uniswap v4 pool in a single transaction, placing 100% of the token supply into permanently locked single-sided liquidity ranges. Pool initialization and liquidity addition are restricted to the hook itself; afterSwap records the net AGL flow in transient storage to gate the token's transfers to/from the PoolManager.
